motivation: The year-block permutation destroys the temporal ordering, autocorrelation and trend structure of N_eff. Re-evaluate the conditional N_eff coefficient under a null that preserves each island's complete observed predictor sequence up to a circular time shift while breaking its alignment to next-year growth.

primary_null.name: independent island-wise circular shifts
construction: For each island, order eligible transition rows by start_year.
Keep response next_growth, current_total, island identity, start_year and end_year fixed.
For each replicate, draw one circular lag independently for each island, uniformly from all lags 0,...,n_i-1.
Reject only the global identity vector in which every island receives lag 0.
Apply the selected lag to the complete N_eff sequence within that island.
Do not resample, permute or jitter values within the shifted sequence.
preservation: each island's Fourier power spectrum / periodogram
each island's observed trend shape up to cyclic relocation
the original response, abundance and calendar-time series
primary_null.broken_relation: calendar alignment between island-specific N_eff states and next-year growth
primary_null.caveat: Circular shifting imposes a wrap-around boundary and is therefore a structured surrogate, not a literal generative ecological process.

primary_statistic: full-data standardized coefficient of log1p(N_eff) in the frozen C1 model
primary_p_value: (1 + number of circular-shift coefficients >= observed beta) / (B + 1), one-sided for the predeclared positive direction
secondary_outputs: two-sided probability based on abs(beta_shift) >= abs(beta_observed)
held-out MSE-gain distribution under the same shifts as a secondary diagnostic
Monte Carlo standard error of the primary p-value
island sequence lengths and shift-frequency diagnostics

interpretation_rules.association_retained_against_serial_stru: Require BOTH primary independent-island circular-shift one-sided p <= 0.05 and exact joint-shift sensitivity p <= 0.05.
interpretation_rules.association_not_distinguishable_from_ser: If either structured-null p > 0.05, remove inferential emphasis from the N_eff coefficient and retain it only as a descriptive pattern.
interpretation_rules.manuscript_if_survives: N_eff may remain a conditional association, explicitly supported only after both circular-shift controls and still not a robust held-out predictor.
interpretation_rules.manuscript_if_fails: Remove inferential emphasis from the N_eff coefficient; revise synthesis, figures and Ecosphere manuscript before submission.

boundaries: This is a correction to the null distribution for the already-frozen N_eff coefficient, not a new topology endpoint.
No alternative lag restriction, smoothing, phase-randomization method, detrending rule or p-value definition may be selected after results are opened.
The existing year-block permutation p=0.262 for held-out predictive gain remains valid evidence against a robust predictive claim regardless of the circular-shift coefficient result.
The mechanical-coupling simulations do not rescue an association that fails this serial-structure-preserving null.
No causal habitat-fragmentation claim follows from a surviving coefficient.
submission_gate: Ecosphere PR #21 remains draft until this diagnostic is frozen and manuscript/synthesis claims are reconciled.

secondary_joint_shift_sensitivity.name: joint circular shift for four persistent islands plus independent Litchfield shift
construction: CHR, COR, HUM and TOR each have the same 26 eligible transition years and receive one common circular lag k_persistent in 0,...,25.
LIT receives an independent circular lag k_LIT in 0,...,15 over its 16 eligible pre-extinction transition years.
Enumerate all 26 x 16 = 416 lag combinations exactly, including the identity combination.
Compute the same full-data standardized N_eff coefficient for every combination.
preservation: the complete individual temporal structure of each island
the exact cross-island N_eff covariance structure among CHR/COR/HUM/TOR
all response, abundance and calendar-time values
secondary_joint_shift_sensitivity.p_value: exact proportion of all 416 combinations with beta >= observed beta; identity is included as one member of the randomization group
secondary_joint_shift_sensitivity.role: fixed sensitivity to the loss of cross-island predictor covariance under the primary independent-island shift null
